records.source: You finished the Scenario with '{0}' rating.
records.translation: Natapos mo ang senaryo nang may gradong '{0}'.

records.source: I want you to have this sealed envelope.
records.translation: Nais kong mapasaiyo ang nakaselyong sobreng ito.

records.source: No, no, don't open it yet... have patience.
records.translation: Huwag, huwag mo muna itong buksan... maghintay ka.

records.source: There will come a day when you feel crushed by the burden of modern life...
records.translation: Darating ang araw na madudurog ka sa bigat ng makabagong buhay...

records.source: ...and your bright spirit will fade before a growing emptiness.
records.translation: ...at kukupas ang maningning mong diwa sa harap ng lumalaking kahungkagan.

records.source: When that happens, my boy, you'll be ready for this gift.
records.translation: Kapag nangyari iyon, apo ko, magiging handa ka na para sa handog na ito.

records.source: When that happens, my dear, you'll be ready for this gift.
records.translation: Kapag nangyari iyon, apo ko, magiging handa ka na para sa handog na ito.
Ngayon, hayaan mo nang magpahinga si Lolo...

records.source: Dear {0},^^If you're reading this, you must be in dire need of a change.^^The same thing happened to me, long ago. I'd lost sight of what mattered most in life... real connections with other people and nature. So I dropped everything and moved to the place I truly belong.^^^I've enclosed the deed to that place... my pride and joy: {1} Farm. It's located in Stardew Valley, on the southern coast. It's the perfect place to start your new life.^^This was my most precious gift of all, and now it's yours. I know you'll honor the family name, my boy. Good luck.^^Love, Grandpa^^P.S. If Lewis is still alive say hi to the old guy for me, will ya?
records.translation: Mahal kong {0},^^Kung binabasa mo ito, tiyak na kailangang-kailangan mo ng pagbabago.^^Nangyari rin sa akin iyan noong unang panahon. Nalimutan ko na kung ano ang pinakamahalaga sa buhay... ang tunay na ugnayan sa ibang tao at sa kalikasan. Kaya iniwan ko ang lahat at lumipat sa lugar na talagang para sa akin.^^^Kalakip dito ang titulo ng lupang iyon... ang aking ipinagmamalaki at ikinasisiya: Bukid na {1}. Matatagpuan ito sa Stardew Valley, sa katimugang baybayin. Ito ang perpektong lugar upang simulan ang bago mong buhay.^^Ito ang pinakamahalaga kong handog sa lahat, at ngayon ay sa iyo na. Alam kong pararangalan mo ang pangalan ng ating pamilya, apo ko. Nawa'y palarin ka.^^Nagmamahal, Lolo^^P.S. Kung buhay pa si Lewis, kumustahin mo ang matanda para sa akin, ha?
